thread:
maria: Quick gut-check on the vectors preview toolbar. Current mock puts a sticky toolbar with a selection count + two CTAs: "Export vectors" and "Download selection". Curious about the best pattern for a11y + keyboard users. Should the secondary be hidden until select > 0, or visible but disabled?

jonathan: My vote: visible but disabled. Users discover the feature and won't be confused when the UI shifts. Recommend showing a non-interactive tooltip: "Select rows to enable".

sam: Agree on discoverability, but important: do NOT reorder DOM nodes to change primary vs secondary. Reordering breaks tab order and SR muscle memory. Use CSS + `aria-live` to announce state.

leo: Implementation idea: keep DOM stable, swap visual emphasis with `.primary` class. Add a small SR-only status region: `div#vec-status[role=status][aria-live=polite]` that updates to "2 rows selected. Download selection enabled."

aleyna: For screen readers, prefer explicit announcements: include whether export includes IDs and metadata. Example: when user clicks export, announce "Export CSV, includes: vector_id, embedding_length, score." Also ensure `aria-disabled` on buttons, since some SRs ignore `disabled`.

maria: Copy proposal: change "Export vectors" -> "Export all vectors (CSV/JSONL)" and "Download selection" -> "Download selected vectors". Slightly longer but clearer for non-technical users. Thoughts?

jonathan: Fine with copy. Also, add a microcopy line under the toolbar: "Exports include vector_id for mapping. Large exports may be sampled." Link "learn more" to export spec.

sam: UX nuance: if export will sample for >10k rows, surface a confirm modal with sample size + option to download full via job link. Modal should be keyboard-focus-trapped and explain estimated size.

leo: Keyboard suggestions: tab order should be: row checkbox -> row actions -> persist toolbar actions. If toolbar is sticky, ensure it doesn't steal focus on scroll. Use `inert` only when hiding off-canvas content.

aleyna: Tooltip microcopy: "Select rows to enable. Press Space to toggle selection." For mobile collapse (kebab), add `aria-expanded` state to the button. Kebab menu must also announce current selection in its header.

analytics-bot: Event: `export_initiated` available on staging for vec-preview v3. Payload includes `export_type`, `row_count`, `sampled` boolean.

maria: One more: CSV header needs `vector_id`, `source_id` (if present), and `rerank_score` when applicable. Add `--include-metadata` toggle in the modal for advanced users.

jonathan: Concerning performance: if user triggers Export All on a huge dataset, queue an async job and present a link to results. Don't block the UI thread.

sam: Agreed. For UX, show a toast: "Export queued. We'll email you when ready" and include copy for accessibility: toast should have `role=status` and focusable link to job page.

leo: I'll run a quick NVDA pass on the staging build once the PR lands. Will check announcements and tab flow.

maria: Action items: Sam to add modal + sampling copy, Aleyna to draft tooltip and SR strings, Leo to smoke test, Jonathan to add export header requirements to the spec, I'll wire the analytics requirements. We'll also include the small link to export docs in the toolbar microcopy. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
